title: Exclude closed-list bookkeeping and permit additive responsible mutation routes
source: Francisco’s complete CHG-082 execution instruction, 2026-10-11; accepted Nous record delivered in 59380d37922876822e519eb8b86bb0ec03eb14aa on chg-082, based on chg-070 fd73ee31fc9f7aeb1f62ff28881f2a4a516571b0. The emitted CHANGES.md notes are truncated; the user instruction supplies the complete clauses, seven RED fixtures and sequencing authority.

outcomes.statement: The readiness gate counts only delivery paths for future assessments and permits functional items to add responsible routes in mutation-routes.json under a fail-closed additive-only contract, preserving every existing approval and mutation routing result.
outcomes.demo: Seven prescribed RED fixtures pass against the real gate/router; existing readiness digests stay byte-identical; full-table differential routing remains identical, including CHG-079/081 when integrated. Readiness suites and the exclusive-lock awake full gate pass before fast-forward integration into chg-070.

uncertainties.statement: CHG-082 changes the gate that validates its own assessment and historical/pending digests.
uncertainties.resolution: Assess CHG-082 under the existing inclusive file rule: at most 16 paths (12 delivery plus 4 bookkeeping), without the not-yet-supported bookkeeping_files field. Add optional integer bookkeeping_files with no digest normalization/default insertion into old artifacts; new assessments declare it and count delivery only. Determine prospective policy eligibility from immutable assessment introduction and CHG-082 integration/activation history, never an author-supplied optional marker: an assessment first created after integration cannot evade new-policy validation by omitting fields. Historical first-created artifacts retain their prior inclusive classification. Preserve US-075/081/083 and CHG-079/080/081 bytes, approvals and classification. Tests exercise unchanged historical digests and new assessments with omitted marker. No approved or pending assessment is reclassified.

uncertainties.statement: The current model trusts tooling_change and git.mjs does not enforce a script-versus-functional diff contract.
uncertainties.resolution: Keep hard limit 8 and add actual immutable-base/candidate validation for new-policy functional route edits: closed canonical route JSON shape; base routes retained without removal or alteration; only new keys or appended values. Every new key must name a source changed by the item across its own authorized delivery range, not merely unrelated branch edits or only the route commit. Existing keys may gain new values without a changed-source restriction, as the canonical clause requires. Every new value is an existing test path, validated for naming and existence in immutable Git trees. No script edits, exemption/threshold/instrumentation changes are covered by this carve-out. No actual diff file-limit check is introduced. A pure shared policy helper may centralize closed bookkeeping patterns and route validation; mutation preflight remains the execution evidence for new route ownership, not mere existence.

uncertainties.statement: CHG-079/081 route entries exist on us-024 while chg-070 remains fd73ee3; parallel integration may change the immutable routing base.
uncertainties.resolution: Recheck both branches at integration. Preserve those technical CHGs; never undo their work or approve their closure here. Whichever line lands second rebases and moves all integrated inline entries into JSON, records original-to-rebased SHA mapping following CHG-066, and reruns differential comparison over the complete predecessor table including their entries. If chg-070 cannot fast-forward, inform Francisco before integration and reconcile within authorized sequencing; no force update or false fast-forward claim.

uncertainties.statement: The full gate is shared with other active items; dependency setup and gate wait can affect actual time.
uncertainties.resolution: Install frozen dependencies if needed; use CHG-067 shared Postgres fixture. Acquire /tmp/smp-full-gate.lock exclusively, never remove another owner’s lock; run caffeinate -i pnpm check. Record waits/slow runs and median availability truthfully. Mjs/JSON/documentation changes forecast zero mutation shards; prove with item-scoped preflight and record deviation for mismatch. Use CHG-069 touched-shard previews if any shards arise. Authoritative campaign only after fresh adversarial review and repairs.

uncertainties.statement: Consolidated review and complete cost evidence must fit one cohesive technical item.
uncertainties.resolution: One implementer, one reused scoped reviewer, then one fresh adversarial reviewer; controller plans/briefs/records verdicts rather than implementing. One controller session, no more than three resumed sessions or about 200K context. Costs use available transcript usage with provenance; never invent measured token counts. Record phase timestamps, preview_rounds/preview_minutes, implementer/reviewer costs in root_cause and real done.cost. Outside-scope findings are deviations or named deferred hardening, not new items.
